requirement_document:
REQ-DEMO-001: Book Registration

The system shall allow an administrator to register a book in
the library catalog.

Each book must have:
- A unique integer book ID.
- A nonempty title.
- A nonempty author.
- A unique ISBN.
- A total_copies value greater than zero.
- An available_copies value between zero and total_copies.

The system shall reject registrations that violate these constraints.
Successful registrations shall create a book record.

scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with a unique integer book ID, nonempty title, nonempty author, unique ISBN, total_copies > 0, and available_copies in [0, total_copies]
scenarios.expected_result: The system creates a book record in the catalog

scenarios.precondition: The database contains a book with the same book ID as the one being registered
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with a book ID that already exists in the database

scenarios.precondition: The registration request has an empty title field
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with an empty title

scenarios.precondition: The registration request has an empty author field
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with an empty author

scenarios.precondition: The database contains a book with the same ISBN as the one being registered
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with an ISBN that already exists in the database

scenarios.precondition: The registration request has available_copies > total_copies
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with available_copies > total_copies

scenarios.precondition: The database is empty and the registration request has available_copies = 0 and total_copies > 0
scenarios.expected_result: The system creates a book record in the catalog

scenarios.precondition: The database is empty and the registration request has available_copies = total_copies and total_copies > 0
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a book with available_copies = total_copies
scenarios.expected_result: The system creates a book record in the catalog

test_cases.title: Register a valid book into an empty catalog
preconditions: The books table exists and contains no rows
constraints: book_id is the integer primary key
title is NOT NULL and nonempty
author is NOT NULL and nonempty
isbn is NOT NULL and UNIQUE
total_copies > 0
available_copies between 0 and total_copies
setup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS books;

CREATE TABLE books (book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title <> ''), author TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (author <> ''), isbn TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, total_copies INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_copies > 0), available_copies INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (available_copies >= 0 AND available_copies <= total_copies));
test_cases.test_sql: INSERT INTO books (book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies) VALUES (1, 'The Pragmatic Programmer', 'Andrew Hunt', '9780201616224', 5, 3);

verification_assertions.query: SELECT book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies FROM books WHERE book_id = 1;

expected_outcome.assertion_description: The INSERT succeeds and the books table contains exactly one row with the registered values

preconditions: The books table exists and contains a book with book_id = 1
constraints: book_id is the integer primary key
title is NOT NULL and nonempty
author is NOT NULL and nonempty
isbn is NOT NULL and UNIQUE
total_copies > 0
available_copies between 0 and total_copies
setup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS books;

CREATE TABLE books (book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title <> ''), author TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (author <> ''), isbn TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, total_copies INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_copies > 0), available_copies INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (available_copies >= 0 AND available_copies <= total_copies));
INSERT INTO books (book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies) VALUES (1, 'Clean Code', 'Robert C. Martin', '9780132350884', 4, 4);
test_cases.test_sql: INSERT INTO books (book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies) VALUES (1, 'Refactoring', 'Martin Fowler', '9780201485677', 2, 2);

verification_assertions.query: SELECT book_id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies FROM books WHERE book_id = 1;

expected_outcome.assertion_description: The INSERT fails with a primary key violation and the existing book remains unchanged
